text.en:
The name of Bagacay Awitan Elementary School in the Municipality of Labo, Province of
Camarines Norte, shall be changed to Paaralang Elementaria Ng L. Villamonte.

The record of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports bearing the name of the school
mentioned in Section 1 hereof shall be changed and be named to Paaralang Elementaria Ng L. Villamonte.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
